name: Lancaster Valley

climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, hot summer

terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: Pennsylvania's first AVA, in Lancaster and Chester counties around the city of Lancaster. Climate was not a factor in setting its boundary.
